title: land writes its ops rows from inside a test into the clone's real spool, so fixture landings reach the committed sidecars and the proposed LOG rows
goal: bl_land.ops_write writes nothing inside a test run (PYTEST_CURRENT_TEST, as ql_deliver.ops_row and tests.record_run already guard), so no fixture landing reaches the clone's spool, its committed ops sidecars or kblog proposals; a planted test run records nothing. Found by the SP-smqwmchu review: 6412 of the 6613 proposed _logs.csv rows (3556 distinct item ids no commit names) are land.end and land.step of test fixtures, not the retired fleet.

gates.question: What happens to the 6412 proposed LOG rows in kb/_self/_logs.csv (and the committed ops sidecar rows behind them) that describe test-fixture landings, item ids no commit names?
options: after the fix lands, remove those proposed rows from _logs.csv (rows of items no commit names) and propose again over the sidecars, the fixture rows in kb/_querylog/ops staying as history
invalidate each of them with kblog.py invalidate, reason fixture data (they stay in the file)
leave them proposed and never confirm them
gates.recommendation: after the fix lands, remove those proposed rows from _logs.csv (rows of items no commit names) and propose again over the sidecars, the fixture rows in kb/_querylog/ops staying as history
